# Bounded coding-agent assignment

TASK
Implement CSD-NNN / TNN: one observable result.

READ FIRST
Root/scoped AGENTS.md; relevant domain contracts; spec.md; plan.md; latest tasks.md and handoff.md.

STARTING POINT
Base revision, prior completed dependencies, known failures, branch/worktree and resource allocation.

SCOPE
Owned files/modules; required behavior; compatibility; exclusions. Preserve unrelated changes.

ACCEPTANCE
Requirement IDs; success, invalid input, authorization, conflict/retry and persistence cases as applicable.
Targeted checks and required full profiles. External qualification that remains separate.

DELIVERY
Explain behavior and rationale. Run check:changed and required profiles. Record commands/results,
revision and pending evidence in tasks/handoff. Do not claim a merge, CI run or deployment that did
not happen. Report a blocker with its exact next action instead of weakening checks.
